name: spotifree
description: Ad-free Spotify clone with PWA, headphone controls, playlist import & synced lyrics

scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.build: curl -sL https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases/latest/download/yt-dlp -o server/yt-dlp && chmod +x server/yt-dlp || true; npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
